video_title: ¡ENTREVISTA A LUKA DONCIC! LAKERS, LEBRON, REAVES...

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic reflects on Real Madrid's disappointing season
quotes.excerpt: I think it hasn't been very good. It is speculated that you have to win everything.
quotes.quote: I think it hasn't been very good. It is speculated that you have to win everything, but they have had very bad luck. I think that above all the season, but the next one will be better.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Bueno, la verdad que creo que no ha sido muy buena. Se especula que tienes que ganar todo, pero bueno, han tenido muy mala suerte. Creo que sobre todo la temporada, pero bueno, la siguiente será mejor.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the pressure of playing for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I think that we could have gone far this year, but it hasn't happened.
quotes.quote: Surely it is a little similar, but I think that I also had bad luck this year with the injury. I think that we could have gone far this year, but it hasn't happened.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Bueno, seguramente es un poco parecido, pero bueno, creo que también yo tenía mala suerte este año con la lesión. Yo creo que podíamos haber llegado lejos este año, pero no ha pasado.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic evaluates the Lakers' season as a failure
quotes.excerpt: Always when you don't win, it is a bad season.
quotes.quote: I think that bad. Always when you don't win, it is a bad season, so if you don't win, it is not good.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Bueno, yo creo que mal. Siempre que no ganas, es una temporada mala, así que si no ganas, no es buena.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the roster needs to maximize his potential
quotes.excerpt: I always need shooters around me because normally they double me quite a lot.
quotes.quote: I always need shooters around me because normally they double me quite a lot, so I think that I need shooters and some pivots that jump a lot, defend, and put up screens.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Bueno, yo creo que siempre necesito tiradores alrededor mía porque normalmente me doblan bastante, así que yo creo que necesito tiradores y algunos pivots que salten mucho, defienden, ponen tapones.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on individual awards versus winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: The most important thing is to win a ring.
quotes.quote: I want them all, but at the end, the most important thing is to win a ring.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ya los quiero todos, pero al final lo más importante es ganar un anillo.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic praises Austin Reaves as a long-term teammate
quotes.excerpt: He is a great player and he is a very good guy.
quotes.quote: I see him very well. He is a great player and he is a very good guy, so I think that it will go well for him.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sí, sí, claro, la veo muy bien. Es un jugadorazo y es un tipo muy bueno, así que creo que le vendrá bien.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the media's role in MVP voting
quotes.excerpt: It is the media, so I don't have that answer.
quotes.quote: I don't know. It is the media, so I don't have that answer. To play better, I don't know.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La verdad que no sé. Son los medios, así que yo no tengo esa respuesta. Jugar mejor, no sé.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the necessity of an NBA-FIBA-EuroLeague agreement
quotes.excerpt: The first thing is that they all have to be in agreement.
quotes.quote: The first thing is that they all have to be in agreement, otherwise there will be many problems. If they are all in agreement, I think that it can be a very good opportunity.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sí, yo creo que lo primero tienen que estar todos de acuerdo, si no va a haber muchos problemas, así que si están todos de acuerdo, yo creo que puede ser muy buena oportunidad.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on his relationship with Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I have sent him a message, so he has to be very happy.
quotes.quote: I have sent him a message, so he has to be very happy.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Le he mandado un mensaje, así que tiene que estar muy feliz.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the possibility of participating in a 1-on-1 tournament
quotes.excerpt: If they put it, it would be great.
quotes.quote: They say that in the All-Star there could be one, so if they put it, it would be great.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Todos dicen que en el All-Star podría haber uno, así que si lo ponen, pues sería genial.
